text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while going to watch a race with
Daiwa Scarlet for tactical research—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Coming to watch once in a while is always so educational.
That race just now was fantastic too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ――I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who had lost in the previous race
was curled up, hugging herself and weeping...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...
I... I—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't apologize. You did great.
Let's put this experience to good use next time."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, even though... you gave me
such a wonderful race outfit—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
To be so pathetic—
and fail to produce results worthy of this outfit—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Ghk.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Let's head back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet hurried off, so I rushed after her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, Daiwa Scarlet
remained silent the entire time...
choice_data_list: ...Are you curious about that girl from earlier?
...Are you worried about that girl from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —I guess it's pretty obvious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …………I love my racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Every time I put it on, this fiery passion wells up inside me—
I know it's the absolute best outfit for me, bar none.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if that's why?
...I understood it so well it hurt."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She apologized to her racing silks...
Those... feelings of hers.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "And so, just a tiny bit. Just a tiny bit... I got scared."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What if my running turns out to be—
unworthy of that racing outfit...?
choice_data_list: You must really love that racing outfit, huh.
You must really love that racing outfit, don't you.
What matters is how you carry yourself.
What matters is how you carry yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What if my running turns out to be—
unworthy of that racing outfit...?
choice_data_list: You must really love that racing outfit, huh.
You must really love that racing outfit, don't you.
What matters is how you carry yourself.
What matters is how you carry yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I love it so much.
That's why I want to be worthy of that outfit.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the one who looks best in that outfit
out there on the racetrack.
choice_data_list: Then what does the current you think?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The way I was just now—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......That's right. The one wearing the number one racing outfit
has to be the absolute best version of me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "That's why the 'me right now,' shrinking back and imagining defeat, is—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't worthy of me.
Not for the vision of myself that I strive to be—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah! I feel like I've finally snapped out of it.
I don't have time to be wallowing around in melancholy like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Trainer.
I won't be scared; I'm aiming for first place.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Together with that racewear, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brightness returned to Daiwa Scarlet's face,
and she seemed to have found a renewed sense of resolve.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The way I myself ought to be――

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, if I'm this pathetic even before running,
everything's already ruined to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Only by me being number one could I prove that that outfit is the best, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Which is exactly why—
there is no time to cower and brood.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah! I feel like I've finally snapped out of it.
Rather than worrying about unseen results, what matters is the effort right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer.
I'll aim for number one, staying true to who I am.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Together with that racewear, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brightness returned to Daiwa Scarlet's face,
and she seemed to have found a renewed sense of resolve.
